authorities.title: OMB Memorandum M-25-21, Accelerating Federal Use of AI through Innovation, Governance, and Public Trust
authorities.scope_note: Federal agency AI governance, strategy, use-case inventory, and minimum practices for high-impact AI. An AI feature on an audited service triggers an evidence request against this memo.
authorities.notes: Supersedes OMB M-24-10, which has no registry record. Verified in the memo text: CFO Act agency AI strategy within 180 days; governance board within 90 days; annual use-case inventory; compliance plans every two years; generative AI policy within 270 days. High-impact AI minimum practices within 365 days: pre-deployment testing, impact assessment, ongoing monitoring, human oversight, timely human review and appeal, and an end-user feedback option. Whether a feature is high-impact needs human judgment.
